tldr: Mars through the 1st house heats up your body, identity, confidence, and first response to life.
body:
When Mars moves through your 1st house, it adds heat and urgency to your body, identity, energy, appearance, confidence, and the way you show up. You may feel more aware of how you are coming across, how much energy you have, and whether your outer life still matches who you feel yourself becoming.

You may feel more impatient, motivated, protective, desirous, or ready to act. It can help you move something that has been stuck.

The useful side is that this timing can make the next honest move easier to see. This is useful for noticing what your presence is already saying before you explain anything.

The caution: Watch for reacting before you know what you are actually trying to change. The risk is becoming too focused on how you are perceived and missing what your body is telling you.

Mars moves through this house for about six weeks. Give the pressure a useful outlet. Act with a target, not just a charge.
